name: IC Power Linear Regulator — LDO, 3V — VSSOP
description: This cluster contains 3V LDO linear regulator ICs in surface-mount VSSOP packages matching the VSSOP-8_3x3mm_P0.65mm footprint.
selection_hints: Use when designing with 3V LDO linear regulator ICs in SMD mounting.
Require compatibility with the VSSOP-8_3x3mm_P0.65mm footprint.
Select when choosing tier A parts such as LP2951-3.0_VSSOP or LP3982IMM-3.0.
avoid_when: A non-3V output or non-LDO regulator topology is required.
The PCB layout requires a package footprint other than VSSOP-8_3x3mm_P0.65mm.
Through-hole mounting is required instead of SMD.
